name: ytdl
description: Use YTDL on Ops for YouTube transcripts and Instagram, X/Twitter and LinkedIn public posts with original media and separate authored text.

interface.longDescription: On Ops, extract original-language YouTube captions. For public Instagram, X/Twitter and LinkedIn posts, retrieve accessible photos/videos/GIFs and deliver the author-written text separately, without a login or paid API.
defaultPrompt: Extract this YouTube video transcript in its original spoken language; never auto-translate it.
Show the available formats for this URL.
Extract this Instagram Reel's written caption or spoken TXT/SRT.
Retrieve the original media and tweet text from this public X/Twitter status URL.
Retrieve a public LinkedIn post’s photo, video or GIF and its original written caption separately.
